lab.做列表卡片弹性转场：点击列表项时，卡片先放大约 4% 并上浮、阴影加深，其他卡片: Build an elastic list-card transition: when a list item is tapped, the card first scales up about 4% and lifts with a deeper shadow while the other cards and the heading blur and fade; then the card expands into the detail page. On back, the detail shrinks to the card's original place in the list and settles with a slight bounce while the blur clears at the same time. Repeated taps are ignored during the transition; focus moves to the detail heading and returns to the original card on back; with reduced motion, drop the blur and bounce and only cross-fade.
lab.做卡片滑动分拣：卡片跟手横向移动并按位移倾斜（最大约 12°），向右露出「保留」: Build swipe-to-sort cards: the card follows the finger horizontally and tilts with the offset (up to about 12°), revealing “Keep” to the right and “Skip” to the left, with the label growing clearer near the threshold. On release, past 35% of the card area's width or on a fast fling, the card flies off in that direction and is counted in that group; otherwise it springs back to the center, bouncing more the farther it was pulled. Provide “Skip / Keep” buttons, left and right arrow keys, and undo; after the last card, show an empty state with the sorting result.
lab.做大标题逐行切换：标题的每一行放在独立遮罩里，切换时旧行依次向上退出，新行依次从: Build a line-by-line headline switch: put each line of the headline in its own mask; on switch, old lines exit upward one after another and new lines enter from below, 60ms apart; the hero image fades out and shrinks slightly at the same time, then springs back to full size once the new content is in place. On rapid switching, cancel unfinished animations and go straight from the current state to the new content; screen readers read the full headline once; with reduced motion, only cross-fade.
lab.做扇形叠切切换：四张照片以底部中心为轴展开成扇形，当前一张居中且在最上层。左右滑: Build a fanned photo switcher: four photos fan out around their bottom center, with the current one centered on top. Swiping left or right rotates the whole set with the finger; on release, snap to the nearest photo by distance and velocity, settling with a spring (slight overshoot, no wobbling back and forth). The title is replaced inside a mask to match the current photo, and the current pagination dot stretches into a pill. Dragging again mid-swing continues from the current position; provide left and right buttons and arrow keys; with reduced motion, switch directly without the swing.
lab.做照片收拢转场：点击「生成相册」后，网格里的每张照片从各自位置飞向中心点，带轻微: Build a photo-gather transition: after tapping “Create album”, every photo in the grid flies from its own position to the center, piling up with a slight rotation and settling with a spring (each about 30ms apart); once all have settled, switch to the album page, where the pile becomes the album cover. On back, the photos scatter from the center to their original cells. The button is disabled while gathering and cannot be triggered again; with reduced motion, fade straight into the new page.
lab.做相册卡片滑动切换：相册卡片叠成一摞，后面的卡片依次下移、缩小并带 ±3° 旋转: Build swipeable album cards: album cards form a stack, with each card behind shifted down, scaled down and rotated ±3° so its edge shows. Drag the top card sideways; past the threshold it moves to the bottom and the remaining cards move forward one by one with a spring; short of the threshold it bounces back. The indicator and page count at the bottom stay in sync with the top album. Provide previous / next buttons and arrow keys; with reduced motion, reorder directly.
lab.做缩略图到票根卡片的共享元素过渡：点击缩略图，图片从原位置和尺寸平滑放大到详情页: Build a shared-element transition from thumbnail to ticket card: tapping a thumbnail smoothly enlarges the image from its original position and size to the ticket card on the detail page; the old page shrinks and fades out at the same time, and the ticket's text and tear line fade in as the image nears its place. On back, it shrinks along the same path into the same thumbnail. Repeated taps during the transition do not stack; focus moves to the detail heading and returns to the original thumbnail on back; with reduced motion, use a cross-fade instead.
